summary: iter303 frontend regression — D1 (Multi-Lot Wizard), D2 (My Listings responsive), D3 (Hero/CTA gap + FR translations). Logged in as charbel911@gmail.com. All visible flows tested in EN+FR. No backend testing per request.

ui_bugs.issue: FR label 'Révision et soumission' is truncated to 'Révisic' in the top-right tab pill (step bar header). The full text appears in the step bar itself (count=1) and the page heading, so functionality is unaffected — purely a cosmetic overflow.

issues: Uses the browser's native HTML5 datetime-local picker (mm/dd/yyyy --:-- --) instead of a shadcn calendar component. Consistent with other parts of the app but worth noting.

action_items: (LOW) Consider shortening or wrapping the FR 'Révision et soumission' label in the lot-wizard step bar header pill — currently visually truncates to 'Révisic'.

(INFO) The remaining wizard flows that could not be automated end-to-end (Bill 96 Quebec FR title required marker on Step 5, photo-step minimum-1-photo enforcement, Save Lot reveals submit-row, edit/delete lot persistence) require file upload and full 6-step traversal — main agent should manually self-verify these or wire a mocked file-upload path for next testing round.
critical_code_review_comments: Cookie consent banner reappears even after setting localStorage 'bidvex_cookie_consent'={version:1,accepted:true}; the consent state key/format may have drifted. Not blocking but causes flaky automated tests.

Setting localStorage.i18nextLng before login is overridden after auth (server pref wins). The FR toggle button must be clicked AFTER landing on the protected route — works but worth documenting for QA scripts.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (D1 partial — full wizard photo-step+save+edit+delete+Bill96 not auto-tested end-to-end)

test_credentials: Admin charbel911@gmail.com / Anderosli123!@# — logged in successfully, landed on /marketplace, then manual nav to target routes.
seed_data_creation: None — relied on existing 3 multi-lot drafts already on admin account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tested with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://prod-verify-2.preview.emergentagent.com. Cookie consent banner uses localStorage key 'bidvex_cookie_consent' BUT still re-appears in many runs — click 'Accept All Cookies' button. Language toggle is a single button in navbar that toggles between EN<->FR; must be clicked after navigating to the target route post-login. For full wizard completion, set up a programmatic file upload (page.set_input_files on the photo-step <input type=file>) to bypass the min-1-photo gate; without it the wizard cannot reach Step 5 (Bill 96) or Save Lot.
